environments.title: Environments
environments.description: Configure and manage your API environments
environments.permMode_yolo_detail: Allows all file read/write, command execution, and network access. Suited for personal projects or fully trusted environments. Not recommended for production.
environments.permMode_dev_desc: Standard dev permissions, protects sensitive files
environments.permMode_dev_detail: Allows code editing and common dev commands while blocking .env, key files, and system configs. Recommended for daily development.
environments.permMode_readonly_desc: Read and search only, no modifications allowed
environments.permMode_readonly_detail: Can only browse and search code — no file modifications or command execution. Ideal for code review or studying unfamiliar projects.
environments.permMode_safe_detail: Extends read-only with a few safe operations. Recommended when exploring an unfamiliar codebase for the first time.
environments.permMode_ci_detail: Optimized for CI/CD environments. Allows build, test, and deploy operations while restricting interactive and destructive commands.
environments.permMode_audit_desc: Read and search only, for security auditing
environments.permMode_audit_detail: Strictest read-only mode — only code reading and pattern searching. Designed for security audits and compliance checks.
